subject: Request: phased invoicing + extended payment window for Lumenova Health
messages:
From: Evelyn Blake <evelyn.blake@lumenovahealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Marcus Green <m.green@lumenovahealth.com>, Lumenova Finance <ap@lumenovahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Phased invoicing + Net-90 request for pilot

Kimberly — thanks again for the product demo yesterday. We’re excited about Redwood as a candidate for our inference layer. Before we move to contracting, our finance team has asked whether Redwood can support a phased invoicing approach for the first year of the pilot: quarterly invoicing that bundles monthly usage, with Net-90 terms on invoices. The ask stems from our fiscal year close and cashflow timing for pilot budgets.

Attached is a short SOW draft and a spreadsheet showing our expected ramp. Can you confirm if Redwood will consider: (1) quarterly invoices, (2) Net-90 payment terms, and (3) a clause to revert to monthly billing after the pilot? Our procurement team would like to avoid negotiating new payment systems if possible.

Appreciate a pointer to next steps and any internal approvals we should expect.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Blake
Head of Platform Partnerships
Lumenova Health
E: evelyn.blake@lumenovahealth.com
T: +1-415-555-0123

Attachment: Lumenova_SOW_draft_v3.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: qtr-billing-impact-model.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Evelyn Blake <evelyn.blake@lumenovahealth.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Phased invoicing + Net-90 request for pilot

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the clear write-up and the materials. I looped in Jonas (sales lead) and Marissa (rev ops) so we can assess risk and approval path. Short answers: quarterly invoicing is technically possible; Net-90 is an exception to our standard terms and will need senior approval and a credit check; reverting to monthly post-pilot is fine to include as a contractual transition.

Jonas/Marissa — can you review the attached SOW and the ramp model and advise whether we can support a Q1 pilot on the proposed cadence with Net-90? If approvals are required, please advise what signoffs we need from finance/execs and any recommended guardrails (e.g., upfront partial payment, attach revenue protections, or limit to committed minimums).

Evelyn — I’ll follow up with a formal approval path once I hear back internally.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Healthcare
Redwood Inference

Kim/Kimbers — quick read of the SOW and the spend model. Key points from rev ops and finance perspective:

- Quarterly invoicing: low operational lift; we can group monthly usage and issue a consolidated invoice.
- Net-90: high credit exposure for a new account at our ARR band. We’d need an approved credit note and possibly a revenue protection clause.
- Proposed guardrails to make this approvable without CFO signoff: 1) cap the Net-90 exception to the pilot term only (90 days), 2) require a 20% deposit or a credit card on-file to cover overages, or 3) limit the exception to a guaranteed minimum quarterly commitment (e.g., $75k/qtr).

If Lumenova agrees to one of the guardrails, I can process this through deal desk. If not, I’ll escalate to Sean for exec approval for the Net-90.

Next steps: Kimberly, can you ask Evelyn which of the three guardrails they can accept? If they require Net-90 with no deposit and no minimums, mark for escalation.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the internal review. Lumenova can accept either a deposit or a guaranteed minimum; preference is to avoid card-on-file for procurement reasons. Our CFO, Marcus Green, proposed a $50k upfront retainer applied to the first invoice plus quarterly consolidated invoices with Net-90. We'd be open to a pilot minimum of $60k/qtr instead of $75k if that simplifies approval.

Please let me know whether that combination is workable and what approvals are still needed on Redwood's side. Happy to jump on a 20-min call if helpful.

Best,
Evelyn

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 17:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Phased invoicing + Net-90 request for pilot — Exec decision

Team — after reviewing the thread and the counterproposal from Lumenova, I approve the following conditional exception:

1) Accept quarterly consolidated invoices for the pilot period (12 months).
2) Net-90 payment terms granted for pilot invoices, contingent on receipt of a $50,000 retainer to be applied to the first invoice.
3) Pilot minimum set at $60,000 per quarter. If usage exceeds the minimum, overages will be invoiced at the agreed rates on the consolidated invoice.
4) Include a clause that billing reverts to standard monthly cadence upon renewal or termination of the pilot; finance may request earlier reversion if credit exposure materially increases.

Marissa — please draft the revenue protection language and update the SOW to reflect the retainer, minimums, and the revert clause. Kimberly — share this with Lumenova and request their acceptance in writing; once we have a signed SOW and retainer receipt, ops will set up the billing schedule.

If Lumenova insists on Net-90 without a retainer or minimum, we will not be able to approve.

Sean Gallagher
Director, Sales Strategy & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
